results.title: Arizona Attorney General holds town hall on halted aluminum recycling plant
results.description: Arizona Attorney General Kris Mayes held a town hall in Benson asking for feedback on possible legislative changes, after residents helped stop the proposed aluminum recycling plant.

results.title: US and Panama Wrap Up Joint Panama Canal Defence Exercise Amid Regional Security Focus
results.description: The United States, Panama and regional partners have concluded a multinational defence exercise focused on protecting the Panama Canal. The drills strengthened coordination, communication and operational readiness among participating forces, highlighting regional cooperation on security around the strategically important waterway.
